method: ruled loft, square 40 at z 0 to circle r 10 at z 40, each side on one rational quarter of the circle (corner (20, -20) at -45 deg): A(t) = (1-t)^2 A_S + t^2 A_C + t(1-t) M, M = 1/2 int (S x C' + C x S') du (Gauss-Legendre on the exact rational arcs), V = h (A_S/3 + A_C/3 + M/6), z_c = h (A_S/12 + A_C/4 + M/12) / (V/h), wall area = int |P_u x P_t| du dt
note: a difference of definition with the FreeCAD (OpenCASCADE) loft, which runs each side to the quarter at uniform angle (arc length): that correspondence has no exact rational B-spline form, and SolidCraft keeps its surfaces exact; OpenCASCADE's volume is 35125.50 mm^3 (0.13% more). The reference.stl is OpenCASCADE's, so the surface comparison is left out
